⚠️ And ⛔ do not write today's member list in as a bare figure — that is the defect this whole family treats. Name where the declaration is derived, or date the reading.

**ACCEPT — PR objectui#9763.** Verified by the `domain:spec` @ objectui seat (session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`), independently of the dev's report, on `origin/main` `c0b68d14d`.

Reading taken 2026-09-18T03:09Z.

## 1. The write-time ref, re-established here

⛔ Not taken from the card and ⛔ not taken from the report. `git log -L 10,12` on the file, walked against the real history:

```
e304a4ef7 fix(components): route the SVG-hosted renderers' spread through `toDomProps` (#7564)
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.changeset/5632-svg-host-dom-passthrough.md
@@ -0,0 +10,3 @@
```

⭐ Two things make this conclusive rather than suggestive: the hunk is an **ADD against `/dev/null`**, so the commit that wrote the lines is the commit that created the file; and it is the **only** entry in the whole walk, so nothing has touched those lines since. ⇒ write-time ref = `e304a4ef7`, established, not assumed.

## 2. BORN FALSE — confirmed at both refs

`SpinnerSchema` at `e304a4ef7` (`packages/types/src/feedback.ts`):

```ts
export interface SpinnerSchema extends BaseSchema {
  type: 'spinner';
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';
}
```

⇒ `type` and `size`. ⛔ No `icon`. ⛔ No `color`. **The sentence was false the moment it landed.**

Same symbol on `origin/main`: the same two, plus `body?: never` and `children?: never` (the objectui#9256 / ADR-0049 refuse-by-name pair). ⇒ still ⛔ no `icon`, ⛔ no `color`.

⭐ So nothing moved under the sentence — which is exactly what separates this from ROTTED, and why the repair is **outright correction**. I probed the diff for a `DATED READING` block: **absent**, correctly.

## 3. The attribution — and the dev found a stronger proof than the card's

`IconSchema` at `e304a4ef7` (`packages/types/src/layout.ts`) declares `type` · `icon` · `size` · `color`. ⇒ the `icon` / `color` half is `IconSchema`'s alone.

⭐ The decisive evidence is **inside `e304a4ef7` itself**, and I confirmed it: the same commit wrote both renderers' pass-through docblocks, and each is correct **per interface** — `icon.tsx` says `IconSchema` declares `icon`/`size`/`color`, `spinner.tsx` says `SpinnerSchema` declares one key beyond the base, `size`. ⇒ the changeset body **collapsed two correct per-interface statements into one and applied the `icon` side to both**. That is a better account than the card's inference, taken from the write-time commit rather than around it, and it is the lane's 「a name is not a key — a key is (interface, name)」 one level up.

## 4. The replacement

Diff is confined to the one paragraph. ⭐ It names **where each declaration is derived** (file + symbol) and copies **no member list** — and says so in its own text. That is the instruction that mattered most on this card, since it belongs to the family about written-down figures, and it was followed rather than nodded at.

The surrounding conclusion is preserved **verbatim** and ⛔ not assessed, as the card drew the line.

**Frontmatter byte-identical**, checked by me on both sides: `'@object-ui/components': patch` on `origin/main` and on the PR head. `check-changeset-overwrite`'s finding is its documented **case 2**, exit 0.

**The pointers resolve.** Both cited docblocks exist on `origin/main` (`renderers/basic/icon.tsx`, `renderers/feedback/spinner.tsx`) — I checked, because prose that points somewhere is only as good as the target.

## 5. The instrument note, which is the part worth keeping

The dev reproduced the lane's line-anchored blindness on this very corpus: `grep -cF` on the changed sentence read **0 → 0** across a change that demonstrably happened. Re-drawn whitespace-tolerantly it reads **1 → 0** on the old claim and **0 → 1** on the new one, with **two lit controls that themselves span a line wrap** reading 1 → 1 and an absent control reading 0 → 0.

⭐ The lit controls spanning a wrap is the detail that makes the pair mean something: a permissive matcher would light on everything, and a wrap-blind one would miss the controls too. This is the fourth time this shift that changeset prose has defeated a line-anchored probe.

## 6. Scope and window

- `Fixes #9753` — correct; the card's whole scope is that one sentence and nothing is left undone. ⛔ No closing keyword anywhere near objectui#5400, checked.
- `Clause-②: no` — correct; no declaration face moves.
- ⛔ **objectui#5400 untouched**, re-read by the dev immediately before the push as open and unmerged. The window held, so the pending-body channel stays the sanctioned one and this card does ⛔ not need re-triage.

## 7. The finding handed back, ⛔ not fixed

The two renderer docblocks this changeset now points at carry member claims whose population moved under them — `body?: never` / `children?: never` were added to **both** interfaces after `e304a4ef7`. ⭐ Same family, same source commit, same pair of interfaces, **opposite polarity**: ROTTED, so it takes the dating repair, not this card's correction repair.

Declining to fix it here was right — the card's surface is one changeset body and source comments are a different surface. The seat files it: **objectui#9764**, with the judgement the dev deliberately did not make (whether a `never`-typed refusal counts as a declared key for "exactly") left open on the card rather than settled in passing.
